enrichment method: Co-IPs of endogenous human protein of NP cells were conducted using anti-TFEB/ PPP1CA/ SUV39H2 antibody with protein A/G beads (MedChemExpres, USA) at 4 °C overnight on a rotator.
fractionation method: immunoprecipitates were eluted with 1×loading buffer (Boster, USA) and separated SDS-PAGE gel.
instrument: The samples were analyzed by liquid chromatography–tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) on a Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
labeling: The samples were analyzed by liquid chromatography–tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) on a Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
